text.p: Here are the highlights of stories in the Skopje press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories nor does it vouch for their accuracy.
- The Agency for Transformation of Companies of the Republic of Macedonia is revising privatisation in 23 out of 1,017 completely transformed enterprises.
- Have the Macedonian government and German Volkswagen stopped talks on production of the AUDI - A3 model in the republic?
- Only half of the available capacities in Ohrid Riviera are occupied in August.
- Ljupco Georgievski, leader of the opposition VMRO-DPMNE is initiating a dangerous racial regime where the citizens' rights are divided according to their nationality, said the paper's commentary.

- Macedonia has paid some two billion denars or 64 million German marks in the frist seven months to 48,255 poor, which is a great burden for the republic's budget but small compensation for the people.
- Macedonia must pay $26.4 million to the Paris Club and multilateral creditors and 30 million ECU to the European Investment Bank by the end of this year.
- Mixed Macedonian-German company Dr. Oetker-Kamcev began production of 26 food products. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom 389 91 201 196
